heading: side
name: 兩張等大方形卡片＋右側直排標題欄
desc: 左側兩張等寬等高的方形卡片並排、圖片置中；右側窄欄放直排標題與副標，欄底放文字連結；背景分上下兩段，卡片跨在交界上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，左側約八成放兩張卡片並排，右側一窄欄放標題組。區塊背景分成上下兩段不同底色，交界約在卡片上方三分之一處，卡片跨在交界上。兩張卡片等寬等高、近方形；每張卡片中央放一張圖片，完整顯示，四周留大片空白；卡片右下角可放一顆圓形圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。右側標題欄靠上放標題組，與卡片上緣同高：標題直排，副標也直排、放在標題左側；標題組包含標題，可放副標，沒有時省略。標題欄底部靠右可放一個文字連結加一顆圓形圖示按鈕，與卡片下緣同高，沒有時省略。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組移到上方靠左，直排的標題與副標改為橫排、副標在標題下方；兩張卡片在下方直向堆疊，每列一張，寬度約為內容寬度，仍為近方形。背景仍分上下兩段，卡片跨在交界上。標題欄底部的文字連結與按鈕移到卡片下方。

en.name: Two equal square cards + right-side vertical heading column
en.desc: Two equal-width, equal-height square cards sit side by side on the left with centered images; a narrow right column holds a vertical title and subheading, with a text link at its bottom; the background is split into two bands and the cards straddle the boundary.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The content aligns with the page content width: about eighty percent on the left holds two cards side by side, and a narrow column on the right holds the heading group. The section background is split into two bands of different color, with the boundary at about the upper third of the cards, so the cards straddle the boundary. The two cards are of equal width and equal height and nearly square; each card has an image in its center, shown in full, with generous empty space around it; optionally place a circular icon button in the card's bottom-right corner; omit it when there is no content. In the right column, place the heading group at the top, level with the top edge of the cards: the title is set vertically, and the subheading is also set vertically, placed to the left of the title; the heading group contains a title, optionally with a subheading; omit it when there is no content. Optionally place a text link with a circular icon button at the bottom of the right column, aligned right and level with the bottom edge of the cards; omit them when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stack vertically: the heading group moves to the top, aligned left, and the vertically set title and subheading become horizontal, with the subheading below the title; the two cards stack vertically below it, one per row, each about the content width and still nearly square. The background is still split into two bands, with the cards straddling the boundary. The text link and button from the bottom of the heading column move below the cards.
